q: What carbon data should a Ludhiana cycle maker get from its steel tube supplier?
title: Cycle frames: steel tube supplier data
short: Ask the tube maker for kg CO2e per tonne of tube, with the steel route behind it, the year and the boundary. Steel tube is usually most of a steel frame's footprint, so a real supplier figure matters more than your own welding and painting, which come from your bills.
audience: Bicycle and fitness equipment makers in Ludhiana buying ERW and CDW tubes, and the brands asking them

ul: kg CO2e per tonne of tube at the tube mill's gate.
The coil or strip supplier and its route: blast furnace, DRI or scrap based.
The year, and whether it is site specific or an average.

p: Cutting, bending, brazing or welding, phosphating and painting, from your electricity, LPG or PNG bills, split by frames made.
Steel tubes themselves are CBAM goods if exported to the EU, but bicycles and frames are not, so a frame maker exporting finished cycles buys no certificates.

senseible: Senseible reads steel, fuel and electricity invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record, so the tube tonnes and energy behind a frame figure trace back to the documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
